realFolderScript: p='/srv/y/claude'; rest=; n=0; while [ ! -e "$p" ] && [ "$p" != / ]; do if [ -L "$p" ]; then n=$((n+1)); if [ "$n" -gt 40 ]; then echo '/srv/x/../y/./claude goes round a loop of links' >&2; exit 3; fi; t=$(readlink "$p"); case $t in /*) p=$t ;; *) p=$(dirname "$p")/$t ;; esac; else rest="/$(basename "$p")$rest"; p=$(dirname "$p"); fi; done; d=$(cd "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || d=$p; printf '%s%s\n' "${d%/}" "$rest"; cd ~ && pwd -P
